decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No works or development shall take place until full details showing a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor of the restaurant have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.

Condition : 4 - No works or development shall take place until a plan showing a restaurant door opening solely inwards from the street has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.
description: The installation of a new shop front to the premises and the creation of a separate access to the residential upper floors.
